title: Claude Code 2.1.234 — sessions resume the moment your limit resets #Shorts
description:
Claude Code now automatically continues your session the instant your claude.ai usage limit resets, so you never have to manually restart a stalled turn.

Full release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.234
